      public io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable addAlertToField(int fieldId, int alertTypeId, Threshold treshold)

      Parameters:
      fieldId - The unique identifier of the field.
      alertTypeId - The unique identifier of the alert type to be added.
      treshold - The Threshold object containing the limit values for the alert.
      Returns:
      A Completable that represents the asynchronous operation.
